description:
The /tree overlay should show navigation hints to help users understand how to navigate.

**OBSERVED (Elixir):**
- No hints are shown when /tree overlay opens

**EXPECTED (Node.js):**
After the "Session Tree" header, a hints row shows:
```
↑/↓: move. ←/→: page. ^←/^→ or Alt+←/Alt+→: fold/branc...
```

**Where to fix:**
- TreeSelector component (apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tree_selector.ex) should render hints after the header
- The hints should include: ↑/↓ for move, ←/→ for page, fold/branch navigation info
- This ticket is blocked by opi-umz.1 (header must come first)
title: opi-277.2: /tree missing navigation hints row
